brief: A workbench organizer: two storeys, bins on top, a drawer below, all edges capped.

requirements.evidence: Level 0 holds the base cells piece:0,0,0 (full), piece:1,0,0 (full), piece:-1,0,0 (full), piece:0,1,0 (half-n); level 1 holds piece:0,0,1 and piece:1,0,1 (full), with snap:0,0,0 and snap:1,0,0 joining them.
bin:0,0,1 (hex-bin-full-div3, 3 compartments) and bin:1,0,1 (hex-bin-full-div2, 2 compartments) sit in the upper storey.
drawer:0#0,1#cut (addDrawer on the cut face of the half-n base at 0,1,0, lower storey).

capOpenFaces added 19 solid caps on every open face (cap:-1,0,0, cap:0,0,0, cap:0,0,1, cap:0,1,0, cap:1,0,0, cap:1,0,1 entries). check_build reports no OPEN_CAP_FACE issues; meshClash is clear, and lockJoints added joint bolts so the body does not slide apart.

finish.summary: Built a two-storey workbench organizer: a lower storey of base cells with a drawer on a half-base cut face, and an upper storey with two divided bins. All open faces are capped and joints are bolted. check_build is clean (no issues, meshClash clear). The base cell at -1,0,0 is structural only and holds nothing. No props or soil were added, since the brief didn't ask for them. Material suitability is not verified.

lines.label: Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
